meta.title: Origen Caral
meta.description: A collection of digital characters from the cultures of ancient Peru, from Caral to the Incas.

hero.imageAlt: At dawn, three figures seen from behind look at the Main Pyramid of Caral, with a beam of light rising from it; on the left the sea and the desert with Nazca lines, in the background the snow-capped Andes and on the right the jungle covered in mist.
hero.label: Peru, from 3000 BCE to 1532 CE
hero.title: It all began here.
hero.subtitle: Five thousand years of cultures, lands and flavors, in a single journey.

origin.label: The origin
origin.title: A thousand years before any other city in the Americas, pyramids already rose in the Supe Valley.
origin.text: Origen Caral is a journey through the cultures of ancient Peru. Each character in the collection tells the story of its people and takes you to the place where they lived.

journey.label: The journey
journey.title: Eight cultures, eight stops.
journey.listLabel: The eight cultures of the journey

collection.imagePlaceholder: [Render: The Musician of the Sacred City]
collection.label: The collection
collection.title: Characters that hold a story.
collection.text1: Flutes made of pelican and condor bone were found in the temples of Caral. The Musician of the Sacred City is the first in the collection.
collection.text2: Each character comes with its story, a certificate of authenticity and a chip that connects it to the journey.

founders.label: Founders Edition
founders.title: One hundred editions per character. Not one more.
founders.text: Those who join first will receive an edition number from 001 to 100 and exclusive benefits as founders.

meta.title: Founders Edition
meta.description: Only 100 editions per character. Reserve your place on the Origen Caral waitlist.

foundersPage.label: Founders Edition, only 100 per character
foundersPage.title: Be among the first to keep 5,000 years of history.
foundersPage.text: Origen Caral begins with three characters from the cultures of ancient Peru. Those who acquire them today will be founders of the project and will receive benefits no one else will have.

musician.name: The Musician of the Sacred City
musician.story: Flutes made of pelican and condor bone were found in the temples of Caral. He plays for the ceremonies of the oldest city in the Americas.
musician.attributes: Cotton mantle, bone flute, colored beads
musician.image: [Render: The Musician of the Sacred City]

warrior.name: The Moche Warrior
warrior.story: Moche ceramics portray elite warriors in ritual combat. He wears the gold ornaments that set apart the lords of the north.
warrior.attributes: Crescent headdress, gold nose ornament, club and shield

priestess.name: The Priestess of Paracas
priestess.story: The embroidered mantles of Paracas are among the finest textiles of the ancient world. She guards their colors and their symbols.
priestess.attributes: Embroidered mantle, diadem, Oculate Being motifs
